Episode 223. Uncomfortable Meetings (2)
The moment Orgal encountered Manof while visiting the enemy tribe, in the Land of Fire.
Shinu calmly surveyed his territory.

Once, no creature dared to visit this place. Even if they somehow entered without permission, they would only be eroded by the pervasive fire and die. Only the highest-ranking gods among immortals could confront him, and only the mortals who ascended could withstand his fire.
However, now the Land of Fire had lost its dignity. More than half of the territory was cold and hardened, with the fire diminished.
It was due to Luke.
A former war god of the Myungwang Tribe, who invaded the Land of Fire not long ago, had pushed Shinu to his limit.
["Like a mirror, he's a fearful one. If I were not in the state of the yoke of extinction, I would not have been able to guarantee the outcome with him."]
At Shinu's words, Kadun slowly nodded.
He couldn't speak because most of his body was composed of soul energy, and since his death in the last battle with Veradin, he was almost in a ghost-like state.
The power of the fire dragon, a symbol of Zifel's might, had almost completely disappeared, and only his soul energy was keeping him alive.
And between them, there was another person whose life was barely clinging on through Kadun's soul energy and Shinu's authority.
Kelriak Zifel, he too was merely oscillating between frenzy and fainting. The moment he slips out of the 'Ring of Fire' created by Shinu, his breath would be cut off.
[Choke.]
Shinu fell to the floor, shivering.
An hour ago, Luke had come to the Land of Fire again. The second battle with him was even more fierce, leaving far more damage than before.
The reason Shinu survived to let out a hollow voice was due to Luke's mercy.
To be precise, it was not mercy, but just sparing him for the needs of the Sun God Religion.
[Luke will likely return in the not-so-distant future. When that happens, my options will be limited. Either threaten them that I will accept extinction the moment they attack more, or fight.]
Neither offered an exit.
If I accept extinction, it's obviously the end, and even if I fight, I'll eventually be dragged away miserably, unable to even perish, becoming material for the Demon Stone.

Threats didn't seem to work in the first place. If I wanted to not become material for the Demon Stone and instead perish, now was the only chance. Now Luke could hold the power of decision over Shinu's life. Whether to spare or to kill, everything could only flow as Luke intended.

[Among the priests I met this time, many were old members of the Myungwang tribe. There were also those who were suspected to have been war gods in the past. If they appear in the world, wouldn't the result be destruction?]
-You seem to have had a tough fight and are frightened, Shinu. I don't know why the old Myungwang tribe is with the Sun God Religion, but they will not bring about the destruction of the world.
-"I hope you can keep your word. Always be on guard for the witch. On the day the demon world opens, this world will no longer be the place you once knew."
-"I expect you to struggle as you are now and disappear at the right time. That is to say, even if you disappear, the resurrection of the Sun God religion will not be affected."
Shinu was thinking about the conversation he had with Jin on the day they first met.
If things continue as they are, the result that Jin wanted will soon come out. Disappearing without affecting the resurrection of the Sun God religion.
Since being born as an immortal, for the first time, Shinu was feeling a sense of emptiness. All the things he had built up over such a long time were disappearing like bubbles.
How did it come to this...?
Was it a problem trying to have a power that surpasses the Sun God?
The Origin Stone, the original Magic Stone.
After the death of the Sun God, it was made with the power of all immortals.

The original intention of creating the Origin Stone was to prepare for the time when the gods were attacked by mortals, or when the gods attacked each other and the world was on the brink of destruction.
However, the completed Origin Stone was a dangerous item that far exceeded the expectations of the immortals, and they eventually discarded it when the history of the ground was on a solid track.

And the god who first raised the necessity of the Origin Stone was Shinu himself. He was more active than anyone else in making the Origin Stone, and was sure that the Origin Stone would have to be discarded after it was completed.
Yet the reason he insisted on making the Origin Stone was to monopolize the replica, the 'Magic Stone'.

Whether the power of the Origin Stone is as great in reality as in theory, whether it can overpower all gods if it exists, whether it can surpass Solderet and Heluram, and finally whether it can surpass even the Sun God. It was necessary to confirm this fact.
However, Shinu's prediction has been off since that era, which is the error of the Black Sea 5 Kings.

[Perhaps the fragments of the Origin Stone turned into monsters called the Black Sea 5 Kings was not a warning from the Sun God Kinselo, I thought. Or it could have been a prank of the witch Heluram... If I had given up my greed for the Magic Stone and focused on eliminating the Black Sea 5 Kings. Would the situation have been better than now?]
Kadun still had no answer.

Kelliac, who was gasping for breath in the ring of fire, had nothing to say either. If young fire dragon Pie was there, he would have answered something, but Pie was currently looking for the fire dragons that Shinu had sealed in the past. The only one in good condition in Shinu's group right now was Pie.
His existence was a glimmer of hope.
If Pie finds the 'sealed fire dragons', they will have to help Shinu whether they want to or not.
The fire dragons that he couldn't control even though he owed them.
The offspring of fire with power surpassing the first Fire Dragon King 'Tracalnis' and his successor Kadun, there has never been a time when their power was so desperately needed as now.
They could buy plenty of time against Luke, and maybe even burn the soul that is eroding Kelliac.
So, all Shinu can hope for now is that Pie finds the land of fire with good news.
Despite showing off all his divine powers and dignity in front of Jin, it was all just bluff.
Shinu now had lost most of his power and authority, lost his contractor, lost his most cherished guardian dragon, and was discarded by Zi
fel, making him no different from a pitiful existence. That's why when Pie found Tican, he was so starved and doing such a trivial thing in such a state.
Thinking about Jin who probably saw through this fact and mocked him, Shinu felt even more miserable.
[...I think it might be better to just perish, Kadun. Most mortals in the world, they live on by standing against such self-loathing.]
For the first time at those words, Kadun lowered his head. With every shake of his neck, a dark, mixed blood seeped out from between the black scales.

[You probably want revenge. But I have to admit it now, I lost. My plan, which is older than human history, was actually wrong from the beginning, and the grotesque fruit that bloomed through that process eventually fell into the hands of others. We don't have the power to correct the twisted plan or to reclaim the Magic Stone.]
Kadun lowered his head once more.
There was no voice, but Shinu knew what he was trying to say.
[You must be suggesting to join another force, Kadun. We have no value now. If we find the sealed fire dragons, who will accept our request to protect me?]
[Krrrgh...!]
Kadun managed to make a groaning noise.

[The royal family? They are the ones who would first sell us to Beradin to complete the Magic Stone. Even if I contact Jin Runecandel again, I would only make my pitiful appearance clearer. Orgal could protect me, but... he would use Bubar's ability to make us no longer who we are. Even the lowly reincarnation of a fragment god could easily do that, especially now that I'm weakened.]
[Krr, Grrk.]

[Are you talking about the Red Name tribe? They will try to use us as nutrients to awaken their god. It's even worse than perishing. The demon world... ha, I don't even want to mention Jito. Just know that joining Jito, in this state, is the most horrifying thing above all.]

Jito was a being who particularly enjoyed torturing immortals from the beginning. And to Jito, reasons or benefits didn't matter, only pleasure was important. Shinu, as he is now, was an irresistibly beautiful toy to Jito.
Shinu frowned as he brought up the image of Jito and shook his head.
And while he was thinking about the things to prepare for acceptance of annihilation, suddenly, he sensed the other side of the domain of fire opening.
Could it be that Luke is back already.
It's barely been an hour since Luke visited. Luke, too, didn't go unscathed, so Shinu was confident that he would need at least three days to return to the Land of Fire.
However, what Shinu saw moments later was the young fire dragon, Pie.
And an unexpected individual.
"Um, I'm sorry, Lord Shinu. I should have asked for your permission first... But this man relentlessly followed me and entered the land of fire..."
Shinu stared hard at the man standing next to Pie. Even Kadun, who sat up with a jolt, kept blinking his eyes.
[Haha... I thought there was a problem with my insight for a moment, and I was seeing what mortals commonly call hallucinations.]
The man didn't respond to that and slowly approached Shinu. Shinu didn't show any vigilance even as he came within a step of him, and instead extended his hand first.
[Welcome, Joshua Runecandel. Like you, I am a fallen being. The God of Fire, Shinu.]
